text_block_list.text:
While on patrol with Fenomeno, we spot some children playing in the park.
They appear to be playing a game using horseshoe-shaped cards.

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
“—Go—! Phoenix Fanfare!
—Don't give up, Classic Tiger!”

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I'm glad they're having fun... Hm?

At the other end of Fenomeno's gaze was a young boy.
He was silently watching the other children playing in the park.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, you there...
Would you mind answering a few questions?

text_block_list.name: Boy B
text_block_list.text: Eep! H-Hee! I-I'm, so sorry...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
F-Forgive the suddenness!
This officer, that is, I did not mean to frighten you...
choice_data_list: It's okay, I just want to talk to you for a bit.
It's okay, I just want to talk to you for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Boy B
text_block_list.text: Is that... so...?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I see. Because you just transferred here,
it's hard to join the circle, is that it...?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
That is... I wonder.
With me, it would probably just end up scaring them...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Gah!? Boss! Look at that!!

Looking over, Gold Ship had just drifted down the river
and was stepping out of a giant washbasin.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Where the heck is that legendary golden kappa hiding?
Maybe I'll try smearing honey on a cucumber next time.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, well, look who it is!
If it ain't Mame-chin and her buddy!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? Ain't seen your face around here before.
Did you know? At the candy shop on 3rd Block, if you order
'6 kinako sticks with extra sauce'—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Aah!!
Hey, is that a Menko Dasher!?
You've got some good stuff there!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
You sure know a lot.
...As expected of Golshi-san.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: (She can do things that are difficult for me. In that case, what I must do—is clear.)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Golshi-san, could you please play
with this child and the other kids over there?"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Huuuh? Well isn't it rare for Mame-chin
to ask for a favor instead of giving orders?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Sure thing. Treasure hunting's having a huge boom right now, and I was just looking for someone to dig with me.
You'll tag along with me instead, right?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Kh, why buried treasure of all things...
Nothing good is going to come from this, absolutely nothing...
But—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Please.
I humbly ask for your assistance!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...Hell yeah! Let's do this, kid!
Don't ever think opportunity's gonna knock on your door twice!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, kids~!
Let Golshi-chan play tooo!
And bring this one along too~♪

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
...? Ah, that's Menko Dasher!
Let's play, let's play together!

text_block_list.name: Boy B
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah...!!
With Gold Ship's help, the transfer student seems to have joined the circle of friends, but...
choice_data_list: W-Was it really okay to leave it to them?
W-Was it really okay to leave it to them?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes. When it comes to handling kids,
I have complete faith in Golshi-san!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, the priority in this situation
is to help that child join the circle of friends..."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
That role
does not necessarily have to be mine.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Even if I end up being nothing more than a bridge—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
As long as she can spend her days smiling,
that is what matters most!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Heh, heheh... Those guys are pretty good...
They completely ripped one of my arms off...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Um, thank you for your help, Golshi-san.
Thanks to you, that child was able to
join the circle of friends.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Beats me. I was just
following the cosmic wind.
Toot-toot-toot~♪

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Golshi-san? Where are you—
Wait, wh-what on earth is that vehicle!?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I cannot allow something so suspicious
to run around here!
Stop this instantーーー!!
choice_data_list: Why don't you just give them a light warning?
Why not let them off the hook today?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
You're right. She really is hopeless.
Wait up, Golshi-saaan!

As Fenomeno dashed off saying that,
her steps seemed remarkably light and buoyant.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Guh…… While it is true that I owe you a great debt today……
that is a completely separate matter, sir!

"Even while holding her head in her hands, Fenomeno firmly
strove to fulfill her duties."
